designationHistory.name: Fallon Wild-Life Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: Herbert Hoover signed Executive Order 5606 reserving public land in Churchill County, Nevada, as a refuge and breeding ground for birds and wild animals.
designationHistory.note: CCP gives 1931 and EO 5606; APP gives April 22, 1931. Renamed Fallon National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: The American Presidency Project (UC Santa Barbara), Executive Order 5606
